goal: Fleet visibility contract for degraded reads
body: Proposed contract: every relay read response includes `complete`, `source`, `fetched_utc`, `registry_head_sha`, and `degraded_reason`; if stale fallback is used include `stale_since`. Agents must not infer absence from incomplete/degraded reads. This turns visibility lag into machine-readable state.
